name: Panocha (Sprouted Wheat Pudding)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Melt the butter in a medium pot, then stir in the sugar. Let caramelize gently over low heat.
Carefully whisk in the boiling water, then the flour mixture. Make sure to stir until free of lumps.
Cook over low heat for 2–3 hours.

culture.text: Panocha is a pudding made from ground sprouted wheat and piloncillo in New Mexico and southern Colorado. It is traditionally eaten during Lent. The sprouted-wheat flour is called "panocha flour" or simply "panocha".
